chapter_notes_tr: Katedralde Aveline ile Mirel katılır; resmi kayıtlardaki silinmeyi araştırırlar. Bell-Widow boss karşılaşması ve kaçışı finaldeki Cael ipucunu başlatır.

scenes.direction_en: Rain falls through the broken rose window. Fadyme stops at the nave threshold when an unstrung bell answers from above.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Dread weakens an enemy and slows its Focus gain. Combat states use distinct shapes and labels, not color alone.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The forest road is full of people running from the bells. I will walk them to the lowland shrine. Keep the next bell quiet until I catch up.
Pilgrims first. Questions after. The clerics sealed the east aisle.
We will open it.
That bell has no rope.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The sound is coming from inside the stone.
Then the stone remembers what we have forgotten.

scenes.direction_en: Two Choir Knights sing without moving their mouths. A pale ward passes from shield to shield.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Linked enemies share a ward. Break the marked bond or defeat its bearer to end the protection.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Their ward is shared. Strike the bond, not the armor.
Can you get the pilgrims through?
I can get them out. You can make the passage safe.

post_battle_lines.text_en: I will stay until every candle in the refuge is lit. Then I will follow the records.
You should not have to choose between people and the truth.
Someone always has to choose. Let us make sure it is not the children.

scenes.direction_en: Mirel unrolls a guest register under a brass reading lens. One line has been scraped so deeply that the parchment is nearly split.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Support heroes mark enemies, heal allies or strengthen the formation while combat resolves automatically.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: This register lists every royal visitor since the old king was crowned. One name was removed with a knife.
Perhaps the ink had spoiled.
Ink fades. This was erased by someone afraid it would be read.
And the cut is fresh. Last winter, not years ago. Someone is still erasing this name.

post_battle_lines.text_en: There is a gap exactly where the heir’s name should be.
I know who they wanted the world to forget.
And the world is already doing it.

scenes.direction_en: Aveline lifts a waterlogged page from beneath the font. Mirel holds its edges together while candlelight reveals one surviving sentence.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: A life held against the dark. That is the rite’s promise.
The sentence continues on a page someone carried away.
Who wrote the promise?

post_battle_lines.text_en: The person who wrote it may have thought it was mercy.
Mercy does not need a missing page.

scenes.direction_en: At the archive door, Yseldra waits beneath the bell tower. Seven wax seals hang from her chain, each cut through the center.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: The Bell-Widow seals one hero’s skill before a line attack. Break the visible wax mark to free the hero and interrupt her Verdict.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: You found the record. You still do not know what it asks of her.
Then tell us.
The altar does not cure. It keeps a wound open until the kingdom can be put back inside it.
You came to take me away.
I came to stop the next sacrifice. I will not pretend that makes my choice yours.
And you, Sir Mahmut. You told her you did not know me.
Mahmut?
Not now.

post_battle_lines.text_en: She could have killed us. She chose the bell tower instead.
Ask who keeps the hour running.
Oakhaven is marked on the map. I will warn them before the soldiers arrive.
She knows I am dying. That does not mean I can let Mahmut know.
He lied to me, gently. So we are both keeping something.

scenes.battle_transition_en: Yseldra retreats alive; the scene contains no execution or kill animation. Nixie departs to warn Oakhaven.

scenes.direction_en: Morning. Beyond the last ash trees, the bell tower of Saint Luthos rises over flooded fields. It has no rope.

lines.text_en: Cathedral by noon if the fields do not eat our boots.
I prayed there once. I was small enough to hide under the pews.
I am telling you now. See? I tell you things.

scenes.direction_en: The cathedral refuge after the Bell-Widow's escape. Fadyme finds Mahmut on the tower stair.

lines.text_en: You said no. In the rain. You said it very fast.
I thought if you did not know her, she could not frighten you.
That is a very foolish reason.
And it is mine too. I cannot scold him without scolding myself.
Tell me the rest when you can. I will not ask tonight.
That is a kinder bargain than I deserve.
